design: Nonlinear additive five-node SCM transfer with unchanged misspecified linear-Gaussian DAG posterior; paired width-1 vs uniform width-2; intervention budget 8; 29,281-DAG hypothesis space.
interpretation: The width-2 proposal-breadth advantage established in the correctly specified linear-Gaussian benchmark does not transfer to nonlinear additive mechanisms when inference remains linear-Gaussian. Absolute causal recovery degrades sharply for both policies; width-2 is numerically worse on the primary metric and its paired interval crosses zero. This is a model-misspecification failure, not evidence that proposal breadth is intrinsically harmful.
next: EXP-002J2 test nonlinear-aware model-ensemble/local-feature inference before proceeding to hidden-confounder transfer.
